maker: Hangzhou Fengtan Robot Co., Ltd. (Fulltime Robotics)
name: Fengtan 3.2 m putty and latex paint spraying robot
summary: Indoor robot with a multi-joint arm that sprays putty, latex paint, filler or primer on walls in flats, dormitories and social housing up to 3.2 m. Launched by Fengtan of Hangzhou in July 2024.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller or partner found. The maker in Hangzhou names overseas projects only in Singapore and Hong Kong; no English product page was found.

specs.label: Working height
specs.quote: 腻子乳胶漆二合一喷涂机器人（3.2米机型）

specs.label: Putty spraying output
specs.quote: 腻子喷涂的施工工效可达600㎡/天

specs.label: Latex paint spraying output
specs.quote: 乳胶漆喷涂的施工工效为1500㎡/天

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: putty, latex paint, filler, primer (by changing the nozzle)
specs.quote: 实现腻子、乳胶漆、油灰、界面剂等多种建筑材料的喷涂作业

specs.label: Path planning
specs.value: BIM import, manual model or on-site scan by the robot
specs.quote: 兼容BIM模型导入、人工建模导入、也可在现场由机器人自动建模

notes: Multi-degree-of-freedom arm reaches into corridors and entrance areas (maker). Drive not described; wheels assumed.
